decisions.reason: The locking-thread width and 65 mm bushing-space requirements are separately and completely established by their own clause in message 45; the clarified bushing location and attachment do not require another state change.
The candidate's message-45 Event already captures the required 82 mm post-weld internal machining associated with the rod running inside the shaft, so no additional or corrected MODIFY is needed.
The keyway omission is an independent geometry decision explicitly stated in message 45 and is unaffected by the bushing guidance and retention clarification.
The assembly-aligned drawing-numbering instruction is independent of the bushing's location, attachment, clearance, and rod-guidance arrangement.
Relocating and clarifying the bushing arrangement does not change the existing CuSn12 bushing material or the default material for other parts.
The mechanical clarification does not alter the requirement to comply with the usual ČSN/EN drawing standards.
The bushing arrangement change does not alter the client-supplied drawing setup reference.
The bushing design clarification changes model content but does not change the required IPT or STEP deliverable formats.
The earlier preview-drawing implementation claim contains no current dimensional-content state that is necessarily changed by the bushing arrangement clarification.
